documents.description:
ROUND 1. SURFACE: internal/cloudclient/client.go (the Deployment struct and ListDeployments only), internal/cli/sites_cmd.go, internal/cli/sites_cmd_test.go.

HIGH-FLIP-RISK: reachability. The claim is that a NON-platform-admin reaches this data. It was proved by run — see below — but a reviewer must re-derive it independently rather than re-read this brief.

WHAT IS TRUE ON origin/main 95642c550, proved by run against the live control plane and by a unit test:
- GET /v1/sites/:id/deployments applies NO role gate. router.ex:6561 wraps it in with_team_site(conn, fn site -> ...), the 2-arity default, which is with_team_site(conn, :session, fun) at router.ex:10941 — Auth.require_user plus current_team presence, nothing else. A user added with role "member" and holding a session token gets 200 with the rows. The EXISTING test only ever logs in an owner (user_with_team/0 hardcodes "owner"), so the member case is untested.
- bp login stores a SESSION token, not a PAT (login_device.go:175 sets cfg.CloudToken from the device login; PAT plaintext carries a bpc_pat_ prefix and the stored cloud_token has none). So `bp sites deployments <site>` works TODAY from the owner's installed binary, with no env var and no platform-operator crown. This is a DIFFERENT verb from `bp cloud deployments` (the /v1/operator census), which IS crown-gated and which the installed binary does not have.
- The PAT loses, and the two routes disagree: owner+PAT is 401 on the LIST route and 200 on the singular /deployments/:dep_id (which uses {:ability, "read"}). Do not change either route's auth — that is the cloud-console-hardening fence.
- The server already ships 25 keys per row, including failure_class (e.g. BOX_AT_CAPACITY_DEFERRED), failure_reason, content_rev, trigger, stage, source, became_live_at, plus a next_cursor.
- cloudclient.Deployment (client.go:1080) has ELEVEN fields and no FailureClass. ListDeployments (client.go:~1194) issues the GET with no query string, so it can never page past the server's default 100. renderDeploymentsTable (sites_cmd.go:579) prints STATUS - IMAGE_TAG - GIT_REF - STARTED, and on guerrilla image_tag and git_ref are "—" on EVERY row: three of four columns are dashes and the fourth is a timestamp. The reachable human surface carries ZERO cause.

WHAT TO BUILD.
1. Decode what the server already sends: add FailureClass, FailureReason, ContentRev, Trigger, Stage and BecameLiveAt to cloudclient.Deployment as POINTERS (nil = the server did not send it; never a zero-value that reads as measured). Keep the existing eleven fields untouched.
2. Give ListDeployments options: a limit and a before/cursor, so a caller can ask for a window instead of silently taking whatever the server's default page is. Thread next_cursor through.
3. Re-cut renderDeploymentsTable so the causeless columns stop dominating: STATUS - CAUSE (failure_class, or "—" when the row succeeded) - TRIGGER - STARTED, keeping image_tag/git_ref available in -o json. Do not invent a value for a nil pointer; print an explicit dash.
4. Print a summary line above the table with its denominator ON THE SAME LINE, per D107 and D136. From the rows actually fetched: "<N> live, <F> failed, <D> deferred — <pct>% of <T> terminal outcomes, <pct>% of <R> rows absorbed by the build cap". If the fetched window is below a defensible sample, say UNMETERED rather than printing a percentage. For site `search` tonight the honest sentence is: 20 live, 3 failed, 77 deferred — 13.0% of 23 terminal outcomes, and 77% of rows absorbed. NEVER print a bare percentage.
5. The window must name itself: print the oldest and newest inserted_at of the rows the number was computed from. A rate whose window is unstated is the vacuous green this epic refuses.

ORDERED MERGE: open PR #9887 also touches internal/cloudclient/client.go — it CREATES a Pressure struct and adds a Pressure field to Barkpark. You touch the Deployment struct and ListDeployments. Different regions; note the ordering in the PR body and do not re-cut #9887.

DO NOT touch any route, any auth code, cloud/priv/static/app.js, or the /v1/operator census. Do not set PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS.
